items.quote: Additionally, our focus on working capital optimization remained a priority throughout the quarter.

items.statement: Promoter stake will marginally reduce from 72.8% to around 71.5-72% after QIP
items.quote: So, before QIP, promoter stake was approximately 72.8%. With QIP, it will, I have not exact numbers, but it will marginally reduce to around 71.5% or 72%.

items.statement: Reduced third-party unskilled manpower by 20% and overtime by 98% from May to August while maintaining sales.
items.quote: So actually, as compared to April versus August, we have done a higher sale. I can't tell the August numbers, but we've done a higher sale, but at the same time July when I say August is still running, but we have reduced the third party, the unskilled manpower by 20% on the over time, we have reduced by 98% percent.

items.statement: 4 MW captive solar plant and 1.3 MW rooftop solar operational; IEX bidding started; expecting significant power cost reduction.
items.period: from 20th July / first week of August
items.quote: We have already this off site, 4 MW of captive solar plant which we had invested which we had partnered with an outside party which were started. So, they have started, they have already gone live from 20th of July of this year and we have already started receiving solar power supply from them close to 4 MW.

items.statement: RACL holds 6% equity stake in the SPV owning the 15 MW captive solar plant (4 MW allocated to RACL).
items.quote: Technically, RACL has a 6% stake in this SPV. This particular facility is actually 15 MW capacity, out of 15 MW capacity, 4 MW is for us, so technically is a captive power plant and as per guidelines, we are actually equity partnered in this company, so technically 6%, around 6% of the equity of this particular SPV is owned by RACL

items.statement: Management states inventory days increased due to higher exports and Red Sea crisis extending transit time to 100 days, but cash flow not disturbed as transit inventory cost is built into costing.
items.quote: Eventually, our inventory days will increase, so inventory is not something which is only our raw material Inventory or finished goods inventory. The real is coming on the transistor inventory. What that cost of the transistor inventory is built up into the costing. It's not disturbing our cash flow.

items.statement: Management confirms net debt will reduce this year as repayments exceed new borrowings, with long-term debt reduction targeted for FY25.
items.quote: It it will reduce net debt will reduce this year.

items.statement: Management acknowledges investor suggestion to strengthen balance sheet via preference shares or QIP but defers strategic decision to appropriate time.
items.quote: We got to know, let this investor call be more focused towards our performance. These are all strategic surprise. Thanks for your message. But definitely these are our strategic decisions and yes, at the right time, the right decision will be on a take.

items.statement: Operating cash flow generation is strong and sufficient to fund capex without equity dilution
items.quote: We want to keep a healthyratio between debt and equity. If required, we'll raise equity also. But until we can manage debt within sustainable levels, we'll continue with debt
